entities.title: Cloudflare Web Analytics
entities.summary: Page views reported by Cloudflare's beacon, which Cloudflare injects into the page.
excludes: Anything inside the game: matches, scores and names are not reported.
entities.details: The page's content security policy allows the beacon's script and reports; nothing in this folder emits them. The Worker writes no logs or metrics of its own: an unexpected error becomes a 500 with { error: "server error" } and is not recorded.
